title: Proximus mobile network disrupted twice on 20 November; company says software bug, rules out cyberattack
geo_basis: operator headquarters in Brussels; the pages name no affected regions
summary: Belgian outlets report that calls and SMS on Proximus's mobile network were disrupted on 20 November 2026, between 09:45 and 10:10, and that problems returned from 12:50. Spokesperson Fabrice Gansbeke attributes it to a software bug linked to an update carried out the night before, according to the reports. Both pages say Proximus ruled out a cyberattack. Proximus says its teams are working on a solution.
plain: Proximus customers in Belgium had trouble with calls and texts on 20 November. The company says it was a software bug, not a cyberattack.
exec: A national mobile network had repeated call and SMS problems; the operator attributes them to a software bug after an update.
impact: Calls and SMS disrupted; the pages give no figures and no restoration time for the second incident.

validation.note: La Libre and La DH (attributed to Belga) agree, but may share one wire report; Proximus's own statement not read. The 7sur7 page in the original lead answered 403.
